item.hha.hell_leggings.lore3: Magma Stomp: %s+ block falls splash 3×3 lava (%s dmg)
item.hha.hell_boots.lore2: Ember Trail: below %s hearts, sprinting leaves fire (%s dmg)
item.hha.hell_boots.lore3: Trail burns through Fire Resistance and armor

item.hha.hells_mace.lore2: Right-click an enemy: yank it to you — %s dmg on arrival (%s quick chains, then %ss cooldown)

item.hha.hells_mace.lore4: Ground grapple: bounce off the landing into a dash — the slap deals %s dmg nearby
item.hha.heaven_helmet.lore2: Halo: trusted players within 5 blocks get Regeneration I
item.hha.heaven_chestplate.lore2: Divine Shield: every %ss a lethal hit leaves you at 3 hearts
item.hha.heaven_chestplate.lore3: Set: Grace — sneak mid-air to glide gently
item.hha.heaven_chestplate.lore4: Set: Ability 1 light beam — %s dmg, heals allies %s hearts (%ss cooldown)
item.hha.heaven_leggings.lore1: Ascension: 3 jumps total (double jump + 1 extra mid-air)
item.hha.heaven_leggings.lore2: Shockwave: fall impact knocks back and damages nearby enemies (%s+ dmg)
item.hha.heaven_boots.lore2: Heaven's Step: below %s hearts, a trail of light follows you
item.hha.heaven_boots.lore3: Enemies in the trail get Slowness I (2s)
item.hha.heavens_sword.lore1: Every 3rd consecutive hit is an auto-crit
item.hha.heavens_sword.lore2: Right-click: light wave flings enemies in a line away (%s dmg, %ss cooldown)
item.hha.heavens_mace.lore2: Right-click: throw 50 blocks — every target on the path is struck by lightning, then it returns (%s dmg, %ss cooldown)

hha.info.overview.title: Hell's Armory — Help
hha.info.overview.1: All Hell's/Heaven's armor is upgraded at a smithing table exclusively from Netherite armor.
hha.info.overview.2: Set keys: Ability 1 = beam, Ability 2 = Fire Camp, Ability 3 = Ultra (defaults G/H/U); weapon abilities use right-click.
hha.info.overview.3: /info abilities explains all shared, Hell's, Heaven's, and Ultra abilities.
hha.info.overview.4: /info commands explains every player and admin command.
hha.info.overview.5: /info all displays the complete help at once.
hha.info.commands.title: Commands
hha.info.commands.3: /untrust <player> — removes that protection. Your area abilities spare trusted players.
hha.info.commands.4: /hha kit hell|heaven — gives the selected SMP kit while kit mode is enabled; always in Creative mode.
hha.info.commands.5: Admin: /hha list displays all enabled abilities and numeric values.
hha.info.commands.6: Admin: /hha toggle <key> <true|false> enables or disables an ability.
hha.info.commands.7: Admin: /hha set <key> <number> changes values; e.g. light_wave_knockback controls knockback.
hha.info.commands.8: Admin: /hha get <key> reads one value; /hha reset restores every default.
hha.info.general.title: Shared Armor Abilities
hha.info.general.1: Helmet: Regeneration I. Chestplate: Fire Resistance. Boots: Speed I and no fall damage.
hha.info.general.2: A complete Hell's or Heaven's set raises your maximum health from 10 to 20 hearts.
hha.info.general.3: Ability 1 activates the set beam; Ability 3 activates Ultra while wearing a complete set.
hha.info.general.4: Cooldown icons above the hotbar show set and weapon abilities: colored = ready, dark = cooling down.
hha.info.general.5: Trusted players and your own summoned allies are spared by your harmful abilities.
hha.info.general.6: Non-OPs permanently bind to Hell or Heaven when first possessing a set item; server operators bypass the lock.
hha.info.general.7: Opposing items may stay in your inventory, but require Helmet, Chestplate, Leggings, Boots, Sword, and Mace before use; first use switches faction.
hha.info.hell.title: Hell's Abilities
hha.info.hell.1: Helmet — Undying Rage: At 3 hearts or less you gain Speed II.
hha.info.hell.2: Chestplate — Warlord's Barrier: Nearby living Brutes grant Resistance I and 2 absorption hearts.
hha.info.hell.3: Leggings — Lava Jesus: walk on lava; sneak to dive and jump to surface.
hha.info.hell.4: Leggings — Falling 6+ blocks triggers Magma Stomp lava and area damage, plus fireballs with a full set.
hha.info.hell.5: Ability 2: Fire Camp grants Regeneration IV and summons 3 allied Piglin Brutes.
hha.info.hell.6: Boots — Below 5 hearts, sprinting leaves a damaging fire trail.
hha.info.hell.7: Full set — Hellforged grants Strength I in fire/lava; Ability 1 fires the burning lava beam.
hha.info.hell.8: Hell's Sword — Crits grant absorption; right-click grants 20 s Haste III and auto-crits (90 s cooldown).
hha.info.hell.9: Hell's Mace — 8 base damage plus vanilla smash; right-click pulls enemies and hurts them on arrival.
hha.info.hell.10: Hell's Mace — Right-click a block/own projectile to grapple; floor targets arm a bounce dash.
hha.info.heaven.title: Heaven's Abilities
hha.info.heaven.1: Helmet — Halo: Trusted players within 5 blocks receive Regeneration I.
hha.info.heaven.2: Chestplate — Divine Shield: Once every 60 s, a lethal hit leaves you alive on 3 hearts.
hha.info.heaven.3: Leggings — Ascension: After the normal jump, 2 additional mid-air jumps are available.
hha.info.heaven.4: Leggings — Falling 6+ blocks triggers a damaging, knockback shockwave.
hha.info.heaven.5: Boots — Below 5 hearts, you leave a light trail that slows enemies.
hha.info.heaven.6: Full set — Sneak in mid-air to glide gently with Grace.
hha.info.heaven.7: Ability 1 fires a light beam: it damages enemies and heals/cleanses trusted players.
hha.info.heaven.8: Heaven's Sword — Every 3rd fully charged hit auto-crits; right-click creates the light wave.
hha.info.heaven.9: Light Wave damages and flings enemies; admins control its strength with light_wave_knockback.
hha.info.heaven.10: Heaven's Mace — 8 base damage plus vanilla smash; right-click throws it 50 blocks, strikes targets with lightning, and returns.
hha.info.ultra.title: Ultra Mode
hha.info.ultra.1: Ability 3 with a full set: HHA cooldowns are continuously removed for 60 seconds, followed by a 5-minute cooldown.
hha.info.ultra.2: Hell's Ultra: Strength II, Speed II, Fire Resistance, Resistance, and a burning damage aura.
hha.info.ultra.3: Heaven's Ultra: Regeneration II, Speed II, Resistance, Jump Boost II, and healing for allies.
hha.info.footer: Pages: /info commands | general | hell | heaven | ultra | abilities | all
item.hha.hermes_summons.lore1: No sender. The seal bears two serpents and a wing.
item.hha.hermes_summons.lore2: Right-click: shows how to build the cloud gate to Olympus. Hermes waits there.
item.hha.hermes_feather.lore1: Proof that you caught the messenger.
hha.hermes.title.forum.sub: All roads end here. Or cross.
hha.hermes.stage.2.sub: Only one casts a golden shadow.
hha.hermes.stage.3.sub: The way to the Styx is short.
hha.hermes.line.prologue.pull: The sky tears open above you — and something pulls you up.
hha.hermes.line.prologue.sender: Ah. For you. Sender: Olympus. Contents: a piece of armor that does not belong to you.
hha.hermes.line.prologue.condition: There is one condition: "The recipient must catch the messenger."
hha.hermes.line.prologue.apollo: Apollo tried it, after I stole his cattle. Argus had a hundred eyes. Not enough either.
hha.hermes.line.feather.falls: A single feather comes loose from his sandal. It is very quiet on the forum.
hha.hermes.line.feather.touched: You touched me. Me. Nobody has managed that in three thousand years.
hha.hermes.line.feather.other_job: Lovely! Then let me show you my other job.
hha.hermes.line.feather.thief: God of thieves, liars and crossroads. Guess which of us is real.
hha.hermes.line.descent.dead_know: You only know the Hermes who carries letters. The dead know another.
hha.hermes.line.descent.every_soul: Every soul that ever died, I led by the hand to the Styx. Every single one.
hha.hermes.line.descent.way_short: Come. I will show you the way. It is short.
hha.hermes.line.descent.serpents: May I introduce? These two, from the staff. They dislike visitors.
hha.hermes.line.zeus.name: HERMES.
hha.hermes.line.zeus.end_it: YOU ARE PLAYING WITH THIS MORTAL. END IT.
hha.hermes.line.zeus.fun: Honestly? I have not had this much fun in centuries.
hha.hermes.line.zeus.rule: So listen closely. The rule says: catch. It says nothing about "without wings".
hha.hermes.line.zeus.feather: The lost feather drifts down to you. Your feet grow light. You can now jump in mid-air.
hha.hermes.line.zeus.breath: He does not watch when I draw breath. Then — and only then.
hha.hermes.line.finale.catch: You reach out. And for the first time since the world began, the messenger of the gods stands still.
hha.hermes.line.finale.delivered: A piece of the armor of heaven, delivered to: you. Take care of it, it attracts trouble.
hha.hermes.line.finale.second_letter: Oh, and there is a second letter in my pocket. Sender: Hades.
hha.hermes.line.finale.hades_seal: The seal is still warm. He never writes twice.
hha.hermes.line.finale.another_day: But that is a problem for another day.
hha.hermes.line.finale.stinger: For a moment, the ground beneath your feet turns cold.
hha.hermes.fail.card: Recipient not found. Hermes leaves a card: "Try again."
hha.hermes.hint.invulnerable: Too fast! He cannot be hit right now.
hha.hermes.hint.fake: An illusion! Only the real one has the golden circle.
hha.hermes.hint.stolen: Robbed! Hit him while he holds the loot.
hha.hermes.hint.stones: He leaps to the glowing stone. Smash it first!
hha.hermes.hint.serpents: The Twins! Stay between the lanes. He stands open in the middle.
hha.hermes.hint.styx: The Styx is rising! Get into the golden area.
hha.hermes.hint.spear: Spears of Olympus! Get out of the circles.
hha.hermes.hint.jump: His last word: jump over the beams!
hha.hermes.hint.fall: A gust throws you back. "Not so fast, the delivery is still open."
hha.hermes.msg.disabled: The Hermes fight is disabled on this server.
hha.hermes.msg.busy: Hermes is busy in this dimension right now.
hha.hermes.msg.need_sky: The Sky Forum needs open sky above you.
item.hha.hades_map.lore1: Black paper, a seal of ash. Hermes never delivered it.
item.hha.hades_map.lore2: Bring it to Hecate's altar at the crossroads: she opens the way down.
hha.hermes.hint.crowd: Hermes grows with you: %s opponents, more health, harder blows.
hha.olympus.altar: Carved into the stone: "Four gifts for the Messenger's first day. Begin where the sun begins, and follow it. Ask the stones if you are lost."
hha.olympus.riddle.0: The eastern stone whispers: "Born at dawn, and out of the cradle before breakfast. Bring what carries him."
hha.olympus.riddle.1: The southern stone whispers: "At noon he built the first thing that sings, out of a tortoise. Bring something that gives a tone when struck."
hha.olympus.riddle.2: The western stone whispers: "At dusk he drove Apollo's cattle away backwards, so the tracks would lie. Bring what remains of such a cow."
hha.olympus.riddle.3: The northern stone whispers: "At night Zeus found him a job. Bring what a messenger carries his messages on."
hha.olympus.taken: This stone has already been fed.
hha.olympus.wrong_gift: Somewhere, someone laughs. That was the wrong gift, and the stones have forgotten everything.
hha.olympus.wrong_order: The sun does not run backwards, even if his cattle do. The stones have forgotten everything.
hha.hades.altar: Scratched into the stone: "The ferryman takes one currency. A single coin, laid under the tongue."
hha.hades.map.found: Tucked between the feathers is a black letter with a seal of ash. Hecate at the crossroads is waiting for it.
hha.tartaros.arrive: Tartarus. Nobody has ever received mail here.
hha.hermes.line.prologue.altar: The gifts burn away on the stones. The altar grows hot, and the sky above the temple tears open.
hha.tartaros.title: Tartarus
hha.tartaros.title.sub: Nobody has ever received mail here.
hha.tartaros.stele.0: Scratched into the tablet: "A wall of bronze runs all around. Whoever came in did not choose to, and whoever wanted out did not manage."
hha.tartaros.stele.1: Scratched into the tablet: "Here lie the Titans, cast down by Zeus. An anvil falls nine days from sky to earth, and nine more to this place. Do not wake them."
hha.tartaros.stele.2: Scratched into the tablet: "Sisyphus cheated death twice. Now he rolls this stone uphill. He has been nearly at the top many times."
hha.tartaros.stele.3: Scratched into the tablet: "Ixion reached for Hera. Zeus bound him to a fiery wheel that never stops."
hha.tartaros.stele.4: Scratched into the tablet: "Tantalus put the gods to the test. Now he stands in water and dies of thirst, beneath fruit, and starves."
hha.tartaros.stele.5: Scratched into the tablet: "Knock on the seal if you must. The master of the house receives everyone. He just does not see anyone out."
hha.hades.stage.1.sub: He was expecting you. Strike when he is open, and take cover behind the pillars.
hha.hades.stage.2.sub: The gates stand open, and the hall itself attacks. Behind a pillar his chains break.
hha.hades.stage.3.sub: Two messengers of death, one recipient. The floor will not last.
hha.hades.fail: You wake before the seal. The master of the house merely showed you where the door is.
hha.hermes.line.hades.enter: The seal cracks. The gate falls shut behind you, and it grows very quiet.
hha.hermes.line.hades.host: Three thousand years, and nobody has ever brought me a letter in person.
hha.hermes.line.hades.excuse: I did try to stop them. Several times. With feathers.
hha.hermes.line.hades.dismiss: Go, Hermes. We will talk later.
hha.hermes.line.hades.rise: And you, sit down. Nobody leaves this house.
hha.hermes.line.hades.helm: I wore this helm against the Titans. They did not see me coming either.
hha.hermes.line.hades.wealth: Everything that ever died belongs to me. May I show you my wealth?
hha.hermes.line.hades.enough: Enough. Nobody has fetched me from my throne since Kronos.
hha.hermes.line.hades.gift: Take the armor of my house and go. I do not let anyone leave twice.
hha.hermes.line.hades.sign: Please sign here. I am back on deliveries. Please.
hha.hades.hint.soul: Your soul hangs on the chain. Run into the golden circle!
hha.hades.hint.march: The dead are marching. Get into the gap!
hha.hades.hint.judgement: His judgement comes. Only the golden circles are safe!
hha.hermes.line.hades.bait: Did you truly believe the lord of the dead could die?
hha.hermes.line.hades.bait2: Again? I am death. You cannot beat that to death.
hha.hermes.line.hades.pact: He made me an offer. No hard feelings.
hha.hermes.line.hades.together: Two messengers of death. One recipient.
hha.hermes.line.hades.never: This never happened. Tell Zeus the same.
hha.hades.hint.cover: His gaze kills. Get behind a pillar!
hha.hades.hint.collapse: The floor is giving way. Get inside the golden ring!
hha.hades.hint.fall: The deep spits you back out. It will not do that for free.
entity.hha.warden_of_chains.sub: Hundred-Hander, keeper of the bronze wall
entity.hha.sisyphus.sub: The stone always rolls back. Today, onto you.
entity.hha.ixion.sub: Bound to his fiery wheel forever
hha.guardian.defeated: The guardian has fallen. This place is free.
hha.hermes.line.hades.gates: You want into my house? Then meet my family first.
hha.hermes.line.hades.ally: Not in my house, Father. Get up, mortal. This time I fight beside you.
hha.hermes.line.hades.seal: Back into the deep. And this time you stay there.
hha.hermes.line.kronos.wake: A crack in Tartarus. After all these aeons.
hha.hermes.line.kronos.son: My son. On your knees. I have swallowed you once before.
hha.hermes.line.kronos.devour: And you, mortal, I will swallow along with him.
hha.hermes.line.kronos.shatter: Enough games. I am time, and yours has run out.
hha.hermes.line.kronos.fall: Chains ... chains again ... Time does not forget.
hha.kronos.stage.1.sub: Kronos is free. Smash his hourglasses before he turns back time.
hha.kronos.stage.2.sub: Hades fights at your side. Keep moving, the floor is ageing.
hha.kronos.title.end.sub: Tartarus holds again. For a while.
hha.kronos.fail: You wake up outside the seal. To a Titan you were only a moment.
hha.kronos.hint.hands: The clock hands are moving! Jump over the light.
hha.kronos.hint.halt: Time stands still! Run the moment it moves again.
hha.kronos.hint.devour: He wants to devour you! Run!
hha.kronos.hint.rewind: He is turning back time! Smash the hourglasses!
hha.kronos.hint.rewind.broken: The hourglasses are shattered! He staggers.
hha.kronos.hint.ages: The floor is ageing! Get out of the wedge.
hha.hermes.hint.returned: Loot recovered! Your effects are back, plus Speed.
hha.hades.hint.chains: His chains! Get behind a pillar.
hha.guardian.hint.boulder: Without his boulder he is defenceless.
hha.guardian.hint.drink: He drinks! Knock the cup out of his hand.
hha.guardian.hint.curse: The stone rolls back! Steer it into Sisyphus.
hha.guardian.hint.titan: She strikes from the Titan! Take cover behind him.
hha.guardian.hint.fallen: Ixion has fallen from his wheel!

hha.boss.hint.anti_air: He wards off attacks from above. Stay on the ground.
hha.boss.arena.gust: A gust throws you back onto the arena.
hha.boss.arena.knocked_out: You were knocked out and came to at the island's entrance. Step back onto the arena to keep fighting.
hha.boss.arena.too_far: You can't hurt it from out there. Step onto the arena.
hha.boss_altar.busy: A fight is already underway here.
hha.boss_altar.need_letter: Hekate demands the Black Letter of Hades. The Messenger carries it.
hha.boss_altar.need_hermes: The forge stays cold until the Messenger has heard you out. Defeat Hermes first.
hha.boss_altar.need_brontes: The throne guard only lets pass those who withstood the Cyclopes' work. Defeat Brontes first.
hha.boss_altar.need_zeus: The throne's seal only opens once Hermes, Brontes and Kratos have been defeated.
hha.hades.altar.moved: The ferryman is gone. The gate now stands at the crossroads on Olympus.
hha.olympus.title: Olympus
hha.olympus.title.sub: The gods did not send for you.
hha.olympus.fall.sub: The clouds let you down gently.
hha.olympus.portal_nether: The water hisses away. The sky cannot be reached from here.
hha.olympus.portal_hint: A Cloud Gate leads to Olympus: build a standing frame of glowstone (inside 2 to 9 wide and 3 to 9 tall, corners optional) and pour a water bucket into it. Overworld only.
hha.olympus.portal_missing: The sky does not answer: this world has no Olympus dimension.
hha.gui.client.portal_shader.desc: Depth view behind the cloud and hell gates
hha.olympus.moved: The temple stands empty. Hermes now waits on Olympus: build a frame of glowstone and pour a bucket of water into it.
hha.olympus.bridge.sealed: The bridge is sealed. Defeat %s and it will close.
hha.olympus.bridge.restored: The bridge closes its gap. The way up is open.
hha.olympus.stele.6: Carved into the marble: "The Horae keep the cloud gate: Eunomia order, Dike justice, Eirene peace. To go home, step back through the arch; it leads to the gate you came through."
hha.olympus.stele.7: Carved into the marble: "The way up follows the bridges: to the messenger, to the forge, to the steps, to the throne. Where a bridge breaks off, a seal holds it until the guardian before it is beaten. The golden pillar shows you where."
hha.olympus.stele.8: Carved into the marble: "Here lives the messenger. Whoever would reach the gods must first be heard. Lay the four gifts of his first day upon the stones, in the order of the sun."
hha.olympus.stele.9: Carved into the marble: "Hecate is older than the Olympians and keeps the key to the underworld. At her crossroads the choice counts, not the strength: when she turns the key, only the path with the golden edge is safe. Bring her the messenger's black letter."
hha.olympus.stele.10: Carved into the marble: "Beyond this gate lies Tartarus. It stays walled up until Hecate turns the key."
hha.olympus.stele.11: Carved into the marble: "Here the Cyclopes forged the thunderbolt, in thanks to Zeus for freeing them from Tartarus. Brontes has a single eye: if a glowing blank lies between you and his hammer, the sparks fly into his face. When the grates glow, find the cool ones with the golden edge."
hha.olympus.stele.12: Carved into the marble: "Kratos, Might, commands; Bia, Force, carries it out and never speaks. Whoever backs off, comes close or kneels when he says so is spared, and whoever stands wisely steers Bia's charge into him."
hha.olympus.stele.13: Carved into the marble: "Every king of the sky was overthrown by the next, and in you Zeus sees the next. His six pillars catch the bolt meant for you; then lead him to the charged pillar. When he raises the scales, the golden bowl is the safe place."
hha.olympus.stele.14: Carved into the marble: "Here stood a temple of the older sky. Uranus ruled until Cronus overthrew him; what remains are columns without a roof."
hha.olympus.stele.15: Carved into the marble: "Post of the Curetes. They struck their spears on their shields so that Cronus would not hear the infant Zeus cry. Whoever lingers before their shields will hear it too."

hha.info.commands.9: Admin: /hha relics [reset|mark|drop] shows and changes which relics have already dropped in this world.
hha.info.commands.10: Admin: /hha progress [set <key> <true|false>] shows or sets the Olympus path and the Tartarus chain.
hha.info.commands.11: Admin: /hha boss start|stop|skip <boss> starts, stops or skips a fight at its island.
hha.info.commands.12: Admin: /hha tp olymp|tempel|dreiweg|schmiede|stufen|thron|tartaros takes you to the stations.
entity.hha.hekate.sub: The Threefold, Keeper of the Threshold
hha.hekate.speaker: Hecate
hha.hekate.title: Hecate
hha.hekate.phase.2.sub: Only one road is lined with gold
hha.hekate.hint.torch: One of her torches is gone. Strike now, before it returns!
hha.hekate.hint.key: The key turns: only the road with the golden edge is safe.
hha.hekate.hint.triform: Three forms. Only the true one holds the burning torch: hit her while they take aim.
hha.hekate.hint.stagger: Seen through! The phantoms fade and she staggers.
hha.hekate.hint.eclipse: Eclipse! Get into a golden circle.
hha.hekate.gate.open: The key turns in the lock. The Gate of Hell at the crossroads stands open.
hha.hekate.line.entrance: You carry a letter that is not yours. At the crossroads it does not matter how strong you are, only where you go.
hha.hekate.line.phase2: The key. Every door I open closes another.
hha.hekate.line.phase3: Three roads, three forms. Only one of us carries the fire.
hha.hekate.line.victory2: Go down if you must. But remember the way back: at the crossroads no one turns around twice.
hha.brontes.title: Brontes
hha.brontes.speaker: Brontes
hha.brontes.hint.ingot: Let him strike the glowing ingot.
hha.brontes.hint.blinded: Sparks in his eye: he is blinded. Now!
hha.brontes.hint.anvil: The anvil shields you from hammer and swing, not from the bellows.
hha.brontes.hint.grates: The grates are glowing. Stand on a cool grate with a golden rim.
hha.brontes.hint.forge: He is forging the wedge: jump over the ember rings.
hha.brontes.line.rise: Another one. They all want the bolt. None of them ask who forges it.
hha.brontes.line.phase2: The forge is burning. Now I work.
hha.brontes.line.wedge: Three blows. Then it is done.
hha.brontes.line.yield: Enough. You hold like good iron.
hha.brontes.line.yield2: Go on up. Tell him who made his lightning.
hha.kratos.title: Kratos and Bia
hha.kratos.speaker: Kratos
hha.kratos.cmd.come.sub: Go to him – then behind him
hha.kratos.hint.shield: The shield catches blows from the front. Strike his side or his back!
hha.kratos.hint.kneel: ⬇ [%s] Sneak! The blade passes over you.
hha.kratos.hint.storm: Bia charges from her plinth in a straight line. If Kratos stands in her path, she rams him.
hha.kratos.hint.clash: Bia rammed Kratos! Both are reeling – strike now!
hha.kratos.hint.bia: Bia takes no damage. Your enemy is Kratos.
hha.kratos.line.entrance: Halt. No one stands upright before the throne of Zeus.
hha.kratos.line.phase2: Enough orders. Now force, without measure.
hha.kratos.line.yield: Might yields to you. Go up. He is waiting.
hha.zeus.title: Zeus
hha.zeus.phase.2.sub: Do not look into his shield
hha.zeus.hint.rod: Near a copper pillar the lightning strikes the pillar, not you.
hha.zeus.hint.lure: The pillar is charged. Lure him to it.
hha.zeus.hint.discharge: The pillar discharges into him. Strike now!
hha.zeus.hint.gaze: Don't look! Turn away or get behind a pillar.
hha.zeus.hint.storm: The storm wall is coming. Only the golden gap is safe.
hha.zeus.hint.scales: The scales: stand in the golden pan when they tip.
hha.zeus.hint.air: The sky belongs to Zeus. Stay up too long and you draw the lightning.
hha.zeus.line.intro.1: Ouranos fell to Kronos. Kronos fell to me.
hha.zeus.line.intro.2: And now you stand before my throne. Show me whether you are next.
hha.zeus.line.phase.2: You do not fear the thunderbolt. Then look at what I carry.
hha.zeus.line.phase.3: I cast my father into the deep. I know how a fall begins.
hha.zeus.line.scales.1: I do not decide. The scales decide.
hha.zeus.line.scales.2: Once more. Put your weight in the pan.
hha.zeus.line.scales.empty: Empty. That is all hesitation weighs.
hha.zeus.line.end.1: Enough. I never sought an heir. Only someone who stands firm.
hha.zeus.line.end.2: Nike, goddess of victory, sets the wreath upon your brow.
hha.zeus.line.end.3: What I locked away down there will not hold forever.
hha.kurete.hint.shield: His shield covers his front. Circle around him.
hha.automaton.hint.valve: The valve on her back is her weak spot.
hha.tartaros.chain.missing: The seal does not move. Still holding their link of the chain: %1$s (%2$s of %3$s broken).
hha.tartaros.chain.broken: A link of the chain is broken: %1$s has fallen (%2$s of %3$s).
hha.tartaros.chain.already: This link was already broken (%1$s of %2$s).
hha.tartaros.chain.complete: All five links are broken. The palace seal gives way.
hha.guide.warden: Hermes points into the distance: "The Bronze Fortress, about %s blocks. The Warden holds his link of the chain there. Follow the pillar."
hha.guide.kampe: Hermes points into the distance: "The Titan Prison, about %s blocks. Climb down into the pit and Kampe will come to you. Follow the pillar."
hha.guide.sisyphus: Hermes points into the distance: "The hill of Sisyphus, about %s blocks. He is almost at the top. Has been for a few millennia. Follow the pillar."
hha.guide.ixion: Hermes points into the distance: "The fire wheel of Ixion, about %s blocks. Do not get too close to the wheel. Follow the pillar."
hha.guide.tantalus: Hermes points into the distance: "The basin of Tantalus, about %s blocks. Whatever you do, do not bring him a drink. Follow the pillar."
hha.guide.palace: Hermes points into the distance: "The chain is broken. The palace of Hades, about %s blocks. From here on you walk alone."
hha.guide.lost: Hermes scratches his helmet: "No warden near here still holds a link. Walk a little further and I will look again."
hha.cmd.olymp.bridges: Sealed bridges restored: %s gaps (loaded chunks only).
hha.info.commands.13: Admin: /hha olymp spawn kurete|griffin|automaton places a test post in front of you; /hha olymp bridges closes every sealed bridge at once.
hha.tartaros.scene.warden: Here waits the Jailer. Whoever touches the bronze wall belongs to him.
hha.tartaros.scene.kampe: Kampe, warden of the Titans. Since Kronos fell, she has never lost a prisoner.
hha.tartaros.scene.sisyphus: Sisyphus. His boulder rolls back forever – today it rolls toward you.
hha.tartaros.scene.ixion: Ixion, bound to the burning wheel. Every turn is a curse.
hha.tartaros.scene.tantalus: Tantalus. Eternal thirst, eternal hunger – and wrath for anyone who is full.
hha.boss.rage.title: Last Stand
hha.rpg.button.tooltip: Group adventure: pick a path, invite friends with a code, start together.
hha.rpg.title: HHA RPG
hha.rpg.subtitle: Group adventure

hha.rpg.hint: Create a lobby and give your friends the code. Four players are recommended, more is possible. The host runs the world on their machine, everyone else connects automatically.
hha.rpg.notice.missing: You are missing addons the host picked: %s
hha.rpg.notice.running: The world is already running. You will be connected directly.
hha.rpg.error.already_started: This party has already set out.
hha.rpg.error.already_in: You are already in this lobby.
hha.rpg.error.rate_limited: Too many lobbies in a short time. Wait a moment.
hha.rpg.error.kicked: You were removed from the lobby.
hha.rpg.error.closed_idle: The lobby was closed for inactivity.
hha.rpg.error.no_hello: Not signed in yet, try again in a moment.
hha.rpg.path.heaven.desc: Olympus: Hermes, Brontes, Kratos and Bia, and finally Zeus.
hha.rpg.path.hell.desc: Through the hell gate into Tartarus: five wardens, Hades and Kronos.
hha.rpg.start.heaven.sub: The path leads up to Zeus
hha.rpg.kicker: RPG mode · choose a path, gather your party, set out
hha.rpg.hint.short: Four players recommended, more is fine. The host runs the world on their own computer.
hha.rpg.start.alone: Solo works too, friends can join later
